hints.title: Subarray Condition
hints.text: Every element in the chosen subarray must appear with frequency at most k.

hints.title: Two-Pointer Sliding Window
hints.text: Expand the right pointer r and increment the frequency of nums[r].

hints.title: Window Shrinking
hints.text: While count[nums[r]] > k, increment left pointer l and decrement count[nums[l]]. Update max length r - l + 1.

hints.title: Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def maxSubarrayLength(self, nums: List[int], k: int) -> int:
        counts = defaultdict(int)
        l = 0
        ans = 0
        for r, x in enumerate(nums):
            counts[x] += 1
            while counts[x] > k:
                counts[nums[l]] -= 1
                l += 1
            ans = max(ans, r - l + 1)
        return ans
```

complexity.notes: Two pointers window with hash map frequency tracking.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use classic sliding window expanding right and contracting left on frequency violation.
